_comment: Prompts for tools/recraft_generate.py (PLAN.md K7). Own sci-fi world (SPEC W40): no names, characters or look of Survivor.io. Edit freely; 'style_suffix' is appended to every prompt so the whole game keeps one style.
style_suffix: flat 2D game sprite, top-down view, clean bold outlines, vibrant teal and amber sci-fi palette, simple shading, centered, isolated object, no text
